verdict: Paid ads remain off; organic Google profile is slipping and needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google — every patient touchpoint came from your Google Business Profile, which delivered 163 actions including 67 calls and 67 direction requests. That profile is now trending down 10.71% week-over-week, and the last three days (Oct 11–13) produced only 8 actions versus 21 in the three days prior, confirming a real dip rather than a statistical blip. Organic search clicks also fell 27% week-over-week, pointing to softening visibility across both surfaces. Profile content is being refreshed to stabilize these numbers before the slide extends into the next reporting window. With the engagement closing Oct 31, the priority is steadying organic performance and closing out the open tracking and CRM items in parallel.
